The provider research task was run with direct official documentation fetches in addition to web searches. The Babysitter collect-context prompt lost stdout because task:post stored it as a stdout artifact rather than an inline stdout field, so the research used the local stdout artifact and direct graph reads.
No speculative graph records were added for updates that already had open issues or whose exact public documentation did not expose enough graph-safe detail.
Issue #1752 was closed as a duplicate of #1755 so DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813 has a single retained graph-linked tracker.
